summary: CI&T Inc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and unaudited interim IFRS financial information for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. Revenue rose 14.9% year-over-year to US$146.3 million (11.2% constant currency), adjusted gross margin expanded 420 bps sequentially to 36.6%, adjusted EBITDA was US$22.6 million, and diluted EPS was US$0.06. The company repurchased US$2.9 million of shares and raised the low end of its full-year revenue outlook to US$568.0 million, implying 16%-18% organic growth. This is a routine earnings filing, not a special situation; no transaction terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated.
